d:
The Timberwolves defeated the Mavericks, 133-94 tonight in Minnesota. Bones Hyland finished with a team-high 24 points along with 8 assists and 5 three pointers for the Timberwolves, while LaMelo Ball tallied 22 points, 9 assists and 6 three pointers in the game. Zaccharie Risacher recorded 22 points, 6 rebounds and 4 three pointers. The Timberwolves improve their record to 9-3 with the win, while the Mavericks fall to 7-5 for the season.
